problem.v127_behavior: The corrected raft stayed authoritatively inverted and afloat, but entered the 180-degree pose in one frame after D3 latched.
problem.release_relevance: An instantaneous roll did not provide a readable water-driven overturning event despite correct Capsized mode, swimmer, reflip, and loading behavior.

implementation.authority: D3 sustained negative flip margin or hard-roll latch in ARaftSimRaftActor
implementation.transition_start: authoritative adapter pitch, yaw, and roll at the D3 latch
implementation.transition_direction: sign of D3 retained-water roll moment with current-roll fallback
implementation.transition_end: exact +180 or -180 degree roll, zero pitch, live yaw
implementation.hybrid_constraint_reason: The reduced rigid-body solver does not resolve the transient air/water volume that carries a real inflatable raft through the unstable side-on phase; D3 selects the event and direction, while the bounded pose constraint supplies that unresolved rotational phase.

v128_impulse_a.decision: rejected because the one-shot 5.4 rad/s seed reached only 18.6 degrees at the first sample

v128_impulse_b.decision: rejected because live buoyancy righted the raft from the 18.6-degree peak back to 12.0 degrees; increasing the impulse risked uncontrolled barrel rolls

v128_constraint_c.decision: rejected because adding 180 degrees to an already tilted latch quaternion produced a non-symmetric endpoint that buoyancy righted to 33.3 degrees

iteration_decisions.v128_final: retained after interpolating latch pitch/roll to exact zero-pitch and signed-180-roll equilibrium while preserving live yaw

decision: Retain v128 as an authoritative hybrid capsize transition. It removes the one-frame flip, preserves v127 floating/loading correctness and D4 authority, and records its unresolved free-surface rotational phase honestly. It is not named guide, art, marketing, press, store, or release approval.
